forward_patch:
--- original
+++ modified
@@ -0,0 +1,46 @@
+---
+assignees:
+- claude-code
+depends_on:
+- 01M19ACG799X8YF41B4BA0C6FV
+position_column: todo
+position_ordinal: '8380'
+title: Cover LanguageModelSession's plain respond(to:) with a real model
+---
+## What
+
+`Sources/FoundationModelsRanker/Selection/LanguageModelSessionSupport.swift:42-44`
+
+Coverage: 66.7% (6/9 lines) with the integration gate ON. Uncovered lines: 42-44.
+
+```swift
+public func respond(to prompt: String) async throws -> String {
+    try await respond(to: prompt).content    // 42-44 — uncovered
+}
+```
+
+This is the `LanguageModelSession: AgentSession` conformance's plain-text method. Running the suite with `FOUNDATIONMODELSRANKER_INTEGRATION_TESTS=1` on a machine with Apple Intelligence covers the OTHER override, `respond(to:generating:)` at lines 67-69, because the existing gated test `selectionTierWithABareLanguageModelSessionReachesGuidedGeneration` drives guided generation. Nothing drives the plain path.
+
+That matters because the two overrides do different things. `respond(to:generating:)` uses the session's native constrained decoding; `respond(to:)` returns free text and is what `AgentSession`'s DEFAULT `respond(to:generating:)` would call for any conformer that does not override it. A break in the plain path would go unnoticed today.
+
+Apple Intelligence is available on the development machine — verified, the gated test passes in about 1.9 seconds against a real `SystemLanguageModel`.
+
+## Constraint — keep it gated
+
+CI has no Apple Intelligence. The `ci / Integration (opt-in, real dependencies)` job is skipped on every run. A real-model test that runs unconditionally turns CI red. Put this test behind `.enabled(if: isFoundationModelsRankerIntegrationEnabled)`, exactly as `AgentSessionDispatchTests` already does.
+
+## Acceptance Criteria
+
+- [ ] A gated test drives `LanguageModelSession.respond(to:)` through the `AgentSession` seam — as `any AgentSession`, not as a direct call, so the protocol witness is what runs.
+- [ ] `FOUNDATIONMODELSRANKER_INTEGRATION_TESTS=1 swift test` covers `LanguageModelSessionSupport.swift:42-44`. Confirm by re-running coverage, not by inspection.
+- [ ] A plain `swift test` with the variable unset still reports zero failures and zero unexpected skips.
+- [ ] No production code changes. Tests only.
+
+## Tests
+
+- [ ] Add to `Tests/FoundationModelsRankerTests/AgentSessionDispatchTests.swift`, gated: hold a `LanguageModelSession` as `any AgentSession`, call `respond(to:)` with a prompt whose answer is stable enough to assert on, and assert the result is non-empty text.
+- [ ] Assert the call reaches the override rather than a default: a prompt that asks for plain prose, with no `Generable` type involved, proves the plain path ran.
+- [ ] Report both runs in the step record: with the variable set, and with it unset.
+
+## Workflow
+- Use `/tdd` — write failing tests first, then implement to make them pass. #coverage-gap
\ No newline at end of file
